ThreeJam example games

Seven 2D games made with ThreeJam, a game engine on Three.js where your coding agent proves what its game does. Each one is a single HTML file from threejam export.

These games need a keyboard. On a phone or tablet without one, only Asteroids plays: tap to start, then hold a finger where you want to shoot.

  • Pong: two players at one keyboard, first to 7 points. W and S move the left paddle, Up and Down the right; Space starts. Code: games/pong
  • Breakout: clear every brick with three lives. Left and Right, or A and D, move the paddle; Space serves. Code: games/breakout
  • Snake: eat apples to grow, and don't hit a wall or yourself. An arrow key starts the snake, and the arrow keys turn it; Space plays again. Code: games/snake
  • Flappy: flap through the gaps between the pipes. Space starts a run, and each press flaps. Code: games/flappy
  • Invaders: clear the wave before the invaders reach the bottom. Left and Right move the cannon; Space starts and fires, and holding it keeps firing. Code: games/invaders
  • Tetris: fill rows to clear them, until a new piece has no room. Left and Right move the piece, Up rotates it, and Down drops it faster; Space starts. Code: games/tetris
  • Asteroids: shoot the rocks, which split when hit, and don't let them hit you. Left and Right turn, Up thrusts, and Space fires; or hold the mouse to aim and fire, and the right button to thrust. Space or a click starts. Code: games/asteroids
